auditor: recover_weights agent, independent of generation and both semantic judges
scope: Read-only artifact integrity and adjudication consistency audit of the completed new 2026-10-02 repeated-holdout diagnostic. This does not restore lost 2026-10-01 responses or training metrics.

inventory_scope.root_owned_later_files: Any later reconciliation.json or documentation changes are outside this frozen snapshot and require publication verification by root.

checks.production_parser_result: All exactly match archived assessment objects using unchanged production assess(), invoked read-only outside this Python audit.

practical_limits: Integrity/consistency review does not replace semantic expert judgment; the two judges independently authored the locked assessments before their comparison.
The reused 24-case holdout was previously inspected and is a development diagnostic, not untouched confirmation data.

Large model/weight/executable files under models/ were not rehashed by this archive audit. Their existing recovery, generation and explicit-validation receipts are bound; this audit checked their declared paths and sizes only.
Source/log text was screened for explicit credential and signed-URL patterns; this does not prove absence of every possible secret format.
Raw model outputs are stored byte-for-byte; JSON syntax validation applies to archive JSON/JSONL containers, not a requirement that model stdout itself be valid JSON.
Empty or partial-named historical process logs are retained as evidence. The complete flags apply to this new 48-response run, not the lost earlier archive.
